name: cat-bootstrap-render
description: The skills for RENDERING cat-bootstrap's own graph as .jsonld/.json. Separate from `cat-bootstrap/skills/` — that package is about READING a knowledge graph cold and about the initialization flow; this one is about cat-bootstrap EMITTING its own. They were conflated while this directory did not exist, and the emission discipline lived in a code comment and a workflow YAML comment rather than in any skill. Bean `hfkl`: cat-bootstrap is exempt from the visualiser requirement every layer above it carries, and its .json/.jsonld is what it owes instead — so the skills governing that emission are the substance of the exemption, not documentation of it.
